description: Documents that pin what the OpenUI 0.8.0 validator and the angular-django2 schematics accept and reject. Each case names its stage: grammar, document, catalog and contract are reported by @shlomoa/openui-spec with the listed diagnostics; schematic cases are valid documents that a schematic rejects; valid cases report nothing.

cases.summary: The pre-0.6.0 bracket key form is no longer a valid attribute key.
The pre-0.6.0 parenthesis key form is no longer a valid attribute key.
An attribute value is a scalar or a list of scalars, never an object.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.title: grammar/invalid-attribute-value: a value must be a string, number, boolean, null, or a list of these

cases.summary: A list holds scalars only, so lists do not nest.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.tags: grammar/invalid-attribute-value: a value must be a string, number, boolean, null, or a list of these

cases.summary: An element id is camelCase alphanumeric.
Every element has a type.
Configuration belongs in attrs, not in a loose member.
A document declares the spec version the tool implements, exactly.
diagnostics: /version: document/unsupported-version: spec version 0.4.0 is not 0.8.0, the version this tool implements

cases.summary: Element ids are unique in the whole document.
A type is an exact, case-sensitive catalog literal.
diagnostics: /children/0/type: catalog/unknown-type: unknown OpenUI object type: Buton

cases.summary: A quoted string is a string literal, not a boolean.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.disabled: contract/wrong-value-type: uses.disabled must be boolean, not "\"yes\""

cases.summary: A declared string attribute does not take a number.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.label: contract/wrong-value-type: uses.label must be string, not 42

cases.summary: A reference names an element of the same document.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.route: contract/unresolved-reference: uses.route names no element: missingRoute

cases.summary: A typed reference names an element of the declared type.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.route: contract/wrong-reference-type: uses.route names a Form, not a Route

cases.summary: An enum attribute takes one of its listed values.
diagnostics: /children/0/attrs/uses.dir: contract/wrong-value-type: uses.dir must be enum(ltr|rtl|auto), not "\"sideways\""

cases.summary: The validator accepts an unquoted expression for a typed attribute, a null marker, a list, and an unprefixed key.
An unquoted uses.* string is a binding expression; the schematics generate static code.
cases.error: must be a quoted string literal

cases.summary: A boolean is the JSON value true or false.
A number is a JSON number.
The schematics reject attributes they do not read instead of ignoring them.
uses.slot is header, content, or actions.
cases.error: is not a supported slot. Supported slots: header, content, actions.

cases.summary: A page is registered under the Route that targets it.
cases.error: is not the uses.target of any Route

cases.summary: A page is content-only; its path belongs to the Route.
A reference is a quoted element id.
cases.error: must be a quoted element-id string

cases.summary: uses.type must agree with the node type.
uses.data is <apiPath>#<ApiService>.
